/*# sourceURL=global-styles-inline-css */ </style><link rel="stylesheet" id="cookie-law-info-css" href="https://veganjobs.com/wp-content/plugins/cookie-law-info/legacy/public/css/cookie-law-info-public.css?ver=3.2.10" type="text/css" media="all"><link rel="stylesheet" id="cookie-law-info-gdpr-css" href="https://veganjobs.com/wp-content/plugins/cookie-law-info/legacy/public/css/cookie-law-info-gdpr.css?ver=3.2.10" type="text/css" media="all"> <style id="vj-simple-share-inline-css" type="text/css"> .vj-share-buttons {

 display: flex;

 flex-wrap: wrap;

 justify-content: center;

 align-items: center;

 gap: 6px;              /* even spacing between items (including the group) */

 margin-top: 6px;

}

.vj-share-button {

 display: inline-flex;

 align-items: center;

 justify-content: center;

 padding: 0;

 border: none;

 background: transparent;

 text-decoration: none;

}

.vj-share-button:focus {

 outline: 2px solid #5eac00;

 outline-offset: 2px;

}

/* Group that holds email + share so they wrap together */

.vj-share-secondary {

 display: inline-flex;

 flex-wrap: nowrap;

 gap: 6px;              /* same spacing between email + share as other icons */

}

/* Base icon styling – applies to ALL icons */

.vj-share-icon {

 display: block;

 max-height: 42px;      /* cap for your 64x64 icons */

 width: auto;

 height: auto;

 border: 0;

 box-shadow: none;

}

/* Text label fallback (only used if an icon is missing) */

.vj-share-label {

 font-size: 13px;

 color: #53768a;

}

/* Copy/share fallback style when there's NO icon (not used now, but safe) */

.vj-share-copy .vj-share-label {

 padding: 4px 8px;

 border-radius: 4px;

 border: 1px solid #d0d7dd;

 background: #ffffff;

}

.vj-share-copy:hover .vj-share-label {

 border-color: #5eac00;

 color: #4b8900;

 background: #f4fbef;

}

@media (max-width: 768px) {

 .vj-share-buttons {

 justify-content: center;

 }

}

document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {

 var btn = e.target.closest('.vj-share-copy');

 if (!btn) return;

 e.preventDefault();

 var url = btn.getAttribute('data-share-url');

 if (!url) return;

 // Native share sheet if available (mobile and some desktops)

 if (navigator.share) {

 navigator.share({

 title: document.title,

 text: 'Check out this job on VeganJobs',

 url: url

 }).catch(function (err) {

 // user cancelled or not supported; no action needed

 });

 return;

 }

 // Clipboard API if available

 if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {

 navigator.clipboard.writeText(url).then(function () {

 alert('Link copied to clipboard.');

 }).catch(function () {

 fallbackCopy(url);

 });

 } else {

 fallbackCopy(url);

 }

 function fallbackCopy(text) {

 var input = document.createElement('input');

 input.type = 'text';

 input.value = text;

 document.body.appendChild(input);

 input.select();

 try {

 document.execCommand('copy');

 } catch (err) {

 // ignore

 }

 document.body.removeChild(input);

 alert('Link copied to clipboard.');

 }

});

/* ================= Candidate Nav - compact, centered, half-rounded ================= */

/* Desktop: original float layout */

#nav_menu-7 { float: left; width: 100%; overflow: hidden; position: relative; }

#nav_menu-7 ul {

 margin: 5px 0;

 padding: 1px !important;

 clear: left;

 float: left;

 list-style: none;

 position: relative;

 left: 50%;

 text-align: center;

}

#nav_menu-7 ul li {

 background: transparent;

 display: block;

 float: left;

 list-style: none;

 margin: 0 0 10px 5px;  /* tighter gaps */

 position: relative;

 right: 50%;

 border: 0;

}

/* Anchor: tighter than employer to fit more items */

#nav_menu-7 ul li > a {

 display: inline-flex;

 align-items: center;

 justify-content: center;

 box-sizing: border-box;

 min-height: 32px;

 line-height: 1;

 padding: 0 9px;

 border-radius: 10px;

 background-color: #7dc246;

 background-image: linear-gradient(180deg, #7dc246, #6aae3e);

 background-repeat: no-repeat;

 background-size: 100% 100%;

 border: 1px solid #6aae3e;

 color: #fff !important;

 text-decoration: none;

 text-transform: uppercase;

 font: bold 13px/1 Arial, sans-serif;

 letter-spacing: .35px;

 white-space: nowrap;

 text-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.22);

 box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.22);

 transition: transform .2s, box-shadow .2s, border-color .2s, background-color .15s, background-image .15s;

}

/* Hover/Focus on anchor */

#nav_menu-7 ul li > a:hover,

#nav_menu-7 ul li > a:focus {

 background-color: #649e36;

 background-image: linear-gradient(180deg, #649e36, #5a8e31);

 border-color: #649e36 !important;

 color: #fff !important;

 transform: translateY(-1px);

 box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.24);

 outline: none;

}

/* Prevent LI hover squares */

#nav_menu-7 ul li:hover,

#nav_menu-7 ul li:focus { background: transparent !important; box-shadow: none !important; border: 0 !important; }

/* Current item */

#nav_menu-7 .current-menu-item > a,

#nav_menu-7 .current_page_item > a {

 background-color: #649e36 !important;

 background-image: linear-gradient(180deg, #649e36, #5a8e31) !important;

 border-color: #649e36 !important;

}

/* Mobile */

@media (max-width: 768px) {

 #nav_menu-7 ul {

 display: flex !important;

 flex-wrap: wrap !important;

 justify-content: center !important;

 align-items: center !important;

 gap: 8px !important;

 left: auto !important;

 position: static !important;

 float: none !important;

 padding: 0 10px !important;

 margin: 8px auto !important;

 width: 100%;

 text-align: center !important;

 }

 #nav_menu-7 ul li {

 float: none !important;

 right: auto !important;

 position: static !important;

 flex: 0 0 auto !important;

 margin: 0 !important;

 background: transparent !important;

 }

 #nav_menu-7 ul li > a {

 min-height: 28px !important;

 padding: 4px 8px !important;

 font-size: 12.5px !important;

 border-radius: 8px !important;

 background-color: #7dc246 !important;

 background-image: linear-gradient(180deg, #7dc246, #6aae3e) !important;

 border: 1px solid #6aae3e !important;

 white-space: nowrap !important;

 }

}  =================================================================== */

 /* Multi-color ring for logged-in user icons */

 .user-profile-widget.logged-in .profile-icon-base {

 padding: 2px; /* This creates the space for our "border" */

 background: conic-gradient(

 #578ead 30deg,    /* Blue starts near the 1 o'clock position */

 #51ab9b 120deg,   /* Teal starts at the 4 o'clock position */

 #ffc107 205deg,   /* Yellow starts at 205deg (40-degree slice) */

 #7dc246 245deg,   /* Green starts at 245deg */

 #578ead 390deg    /* Loop back to Blue */

 );

 }

 /* Creates the overlay, but keeps it HIDDEN by default */

 .user-profile-widget.logged-in .profile-icon-base::before {

 content: '';

 position: absolute;

 top: 0;

 left: 0;

 width: 100%;

 height: 100%;

 background-color: rgba(87, 142, 173, 0.8); /* Semi-transparent site blue */

 border-radius: 50%;

 opacity: 0; /* This makes it invisible initially */

 transition: opacity 0.2s ease;

 pointer-events: none; /* So the overlay doesn't block clicks */

 }

 /* Fades the overlay IN only when you hover */

 .user-profile-widget.logged-in .profile-icon-base:hover::before {

 opacity: 1;

 }

 .user-profile-widget .profile-dropdown {

 visibility: hidden;

 position: absolute;

 top: calc(100% + 8px);

 right: 0;

 background-color: #fff;

 border: 1px solid #ddd;

 border-radius: 6px;

 box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);

 z-index: 1000;

 text-align: left;

 white-space: nowrap;

 min-width: 280px;

 padding: 14px 16px;

 line-height: 1.4;

 opacity: 0;

 transform: translateY(-8px);

 transition: opacity 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease, visibility 0s linear 0.2s;

 pointer-events: none;

 }

 .user-profile-widget.active .profile-dropdown {

 visibility: visible;

 opacity: 1;

 transform: translateY(0);

 pointer-events: auto;

 transition: opacity 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease;

 }

 .user-profile-widget .profile-dropdown p {

 margin: 0 0 10px;

 font-size: 14px;

 color: #555;

 white-space: normal;

 }

 var userWidget = document.querySelector('.user-profile-widget');

 if (!userWidget) return;

 var profileButton = userWidget.querySelector('.profile-icon-base');

 var dropdown = userWidget.querySelector('.profile-dropdown'); 

 var openDelay = 120, hideDelay = 250, halo = 20;

 var openTimer = null, hideTimer = null;

 var isTouch = ('ontouchstart' in window) || (navigator.maxTouchPoints > 0) || (navigator.msMaxTouchPoints > 0); 

 var focusableElements, firstElement, lastElement;

 function setOpen(isOpen) {

 if (isOpen) {

 userWidget.classList.add('active');

 profileButton.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');

 if (dropdown) dropdown.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');

 addCloseListeners();

 } else {

 userWidget.classList.remove('active');

 profileButton.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');

 if (dropdown) dropdown.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');

 removeCloseListeners();

 }

 } 

 function addCloseListeners() {

 document.addEventListener('mousemove', mouseMoveHandler);

 document.addEventListener('click', outsideClickHandler);

 document.addEventListener('keydown', keydownHandler);

 }

 function removeCloseListeners() {

 document.removeEventListener('mousemove', mouseMoveHandler);

 document.removeEventListener('click', outsideClickHandler);

 document.removeEventListener('keydown', keydownHandler);

 } 

 var mouseMoveHandler = function(e) {

 if (withinHalo(e.clientX, e.clientY)) {

 clearTimeout(hideTimer);

 } else {

 hideDropdown();

 }

 };

 var outsideClickHandler = function(e) {

 if (!userWidget.contains(e.target)) {

 setOpen(false);

 }

 }; 

 var keydownHandler = function(e) {

 if (!userWidget.classList.contains('active')) return; 

 if (e.key === 'Escape') {

 setOpen(false);

 profileButton.focus();

 } 

 if (e.key === 'Tab') {

 if (e.shiftKey) { // Shift + Tab

 if (document.activeElement === firstElement) {

 e.preventDefault();

 lastElement.focus();

 }

 } else { // Tab

 if (document.activeElement === lastElement) {

 e.preventDefault();

 firstElement.focus();

 }

 }

 }

 }; 

 function showDropdown() {

 clearTimeout(hideTimer);

 openTimer = setTimeout(function() { setOpen(true); }, openDelay);

 }

 function hideDropdown() {

 clearTimeout(openTimer);

 hideTimer = setTimeout(function() { setOpen(false); }, hideDelay);

 }

 function withinHalo(x, y) {

 if (!dropdown) return false;

 var t = profileButton.getBoundingClientRect();

 var d = dropdown.getBoundingClientRect();

 var left   = Math.min(t.left, d.left) - halo;

 var right  = Math.max(t.right, d.right) + halo;

 var top    = Math.min(t.top, d.top) - halo;

 var bottom = Math.max(t.bottom, d.bottom) + halo;

 return (x >= left && x <= right && y >= top && y <= bottom);

 }

 if (!isTouch) {

 userWidget.addEventListener('mouseenter', showDropdown);

 userWidget.addEventListener('mouseleave', hideDropdown);

 }

 profileButton.addEventListener('click', function(e) {

 e.stopPropagation();

 var isOpen = userWidget.classList.contains('active');

 clearTimeout(openTimer); clearTimeout(hideTimer); 

 setOpen(!isOpen);

 if (!isOpen && dropdown) { // If we just opened it

 focusableElements = dropdown.querySelectorAll('a[href], button:not([disabled])');

 if (focusableElements.length > 0) {

 firstElement = focusableElements[0];

 lastElement = focusableElements[focusableElements.length - 1];

 setTimeout(function() {

 if (firstElement) firstElement.focus();

 }, 50); // Delay for animation

 }

 }

 });

}); </script> <script> document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
